==Description==
'''Jailed Towers''', sometimes referred to as just '''Jailed''', is a [[Modifiers|modifier]] that only appears in [[Challenge Trials]], after [[Flying Enemies]] and before [[Exploding Enemies]]. When a [[Challenge Trials|Challenge Trial]] with this modifier is beaten, it will be unlocked for the player to apply on any match. It also used to appear in [[Sk8 P4rk]] and in [[Jailed Towers (Challenge)|Jailed Towers]] before their removals.

==Effects==
The  effect of this modifier is that, after Wave 5, a random tower type will be jailed every wave for a wave. If a player has only one tower type, that tower will not be jailed on every wave. If it is currently jailed and there are no other tower types, on the next wave no tower will be jailed. Same tower type cannot be jailed twice in a row. Tower type is every specific tower placed down. For example, ten [[Minigunner]]s placed down by a player are one tower type. Units associated with a jailed tower are not jailed. When jailed, towers cannot:
*Be placed down.
*Be upgraded.
*Be sold.
*Have their abilities used.
**The [[Gatling Gun]] is an exception to this.
*Attack enemies.
*Generate income.
*Summon units.
**The [[Elf Camp]] and [[Crook Boss]] can still spawn them.
Jailed towers can still have their targeting priority changed, along with certain other settings. These include the [[Ace Pilot]]'s flight path, the [[Trapper]]'s trap selection, the [[Mercenary Base]]'s unit queues and the [[Jester]]'s bomb selection. These changes do not have any effect on the tower itself until the jail effect wears off on them.
